prose: Basis: the GitHub issue was not retrievable. This is the upstream tracker entry (openai/codex#25921) for the Codex Desktop problem in which the app's Crashpad pending directory fills with paired .dmp and _sidecar.json files continuously - multiple gigabytes and tens of thousands of files per day while the app stays usable.
Yesterday's wiki entry covered a user report of the same behavior: 4.9GB and over 54,000 files in a day, with dumps withheld publicly for privacy.
highlights: GitHub issue for Codex Desktop's unbounded Crashpad dump generation
Same symptom as user reports: gigabytes of dump/sidecar pairs daily
